card.text: The smaller, outer moon of Mars, smoothed by a thick layer of dust.

introduction.text: Loose material partly fills Deimos's craters. Its dark surface resembles asteroids from the outer asteroid belt.

normal.title: Multi-mission image mosaic
normal.summary: Shadows, seams and interpolated poles remain, and missing areas are not marked.

elevation.title: Shape-derived radial height
elevation.summary: Height above or below a 6.2 km sphere from the 2023 model; areas without solved brightness are left out.

albedo.title: SPC relative albedo model
albedo.summary: Brightness solved with the shape from mission images, on the released relative scale.

slope.title: Modeled surface slopes
slope.summary: Slope against modeled gravity, including rotation and the pull of Mars at its mean distance.
